description: The Reilly BOLT is an ultra-lightweight titanium balance bike designed to give young riders their first taste of freedom. Crafted from aerospace-grade 3AL-2.5V titanium and paired with a carbon fork, the BOLT is a no nonsense children's bike that will last a lifetime. Featuring a comfortable, adjustable seat and well-padded handlebars, the BOLT helps build confidence and balance from the very first ride.
